name: wardrobe
label: Wardrobe (one dance, many dancers)
about: One choreography performed by a new character on every beat: bold outfits, seamless studio colour, hard light. Inspired by the Eat It edit.

casting.keep: Keep the exact same pose, body position, arm and leg positions, camera angle, framing and proportions. Full body visible. This one person is alone in the scene. Give the person a completely different face and hair from the original. No glasses. Photorealistic.

casting.video: {who} dances energetically, {where}. Same choreography, crisp motion, full body in frame, both hands empty. The dancer is alone, the only person in the scene.
casting.negative: blurry, extra limbs, deformed hands, distorted face, flicker, jitter, watermark, text, glasses

edit._note: switch_every 'by section': a new character every 2 bars in quiet stretches, every bar in the build (the last build_bars bars before a drop), every 2 beats on the drop, where the motion twins flicker in. Any fixed rhythm ('2 beats', '1 bar', 'accelerate') still works.
